note: Old projects that reference the presets above. `playFromSample` is where the old transport started - mid-way through the first note, 20 ms before the re-attack, so the first analysis window has no history to its left. `markerSample` is the project time marker: the re-attack, which the sound's first effective onset must line up with. Project `old-midstream` uses the readable 2048-sample preset; `old-broken` references the unreadable preset, which must be reported as a preset-read failure and never as an onset/delay fault.
